title: Finite groups with simple or $p$-nilpotent maximal subgroups
summary: Let $p$ be a prime number. When $p$ is odd, we study finite groups in which every maximal subgroup is either non-abelian simple or $p$-nilpotent, as well as those in which every maximal subgroup is either non-abelian simple or $p$-decomposable. We prove that every non-simple, non-solvable group satisfying the first condition is $p$-nilpotent, and every non-simple, non-solvable group satisfying the second condition is $p$-decomposable.
